body:
## Summary
`multimodal-gen-test-1-gpu` testcase **`joyai_image_edit_ti2i`** (`jdopensource/JoyAI-Image-Edit-Diffusers`, `JoyImageEditPipeline`) fails at warmup: the model returns no output and the request errors.

Seen in PR Test ROCm 7.2 (AMD) run [31327057626](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/31327057626) (08/09) and the 08/10 nightly. **Platform-independent** (the testcase carries an H100 perf baseline in `test/server/perf_baselines/h100.json`), so this is a modeling/processor bug, not ROCm-specific.

## Error / traceback
```
[ImageEncodingStage] Error during execution ...: Multimodal data was passed (via `image_grid_thw`
 or `video_grid_thw`) but `mm_token_type_ids` is missing. Please pass `mm_token_type_ids` to the model.

  File ".../multimodal_gen/runtime/pipelines_core/stages/image_encoding.py", line 319, in forward
    outputs = self.text_encoder(...)
  File ".../transformers/models/qwen3_vl/modeling_qwen3_vl.py", line 1240, in forward
    position_ids = self.compute_3d_position_ids(...)
  File ".../transformers/models/qwen3_vl/modeling_qwen3_vl.py", line 1124, in compute_3d_position_ids
    raise ValueError(... `mm_token_type_ids` is missing ...)
```

## Root cause
The JoyAI edit pipeline uses a **Qwen3-VL** text encoder. Current `transformers` `Qwen3VL.compute_3d_position_ids` now *requires* `mm_token_type_ids` whenever `image_grid_thw`/`video_grid_thw` are passed, but `ImageEncodingStage.forward` (`image_encoding.py:319`) calls the encoder without it. Looks like transformers-API drift — the processor produces `mm_token_type_ids` but the stage doesn't forward it (or doesn't request it from the processor).

## Suggested fix
In `ImageEncodingStage` (JoyAI/Qwen3-VL path), obtain `mm_token_type_ids` from the processor output and pass it through to the text-encoder call alongside `image_grid_thw`. (Cross-check other Qwen3-VL-based encoders for the same missing kwarg.)

## Repro
`sglang serve --model-path jdopensource/JoyAI-Image-Edit-Diffusers --model-type diffusion --num-gpus 1`, then the `joyai_image_edit_ti2i` request; fails at ImageEncodingStage. Env in the linked CI run (also reproduces on NV per the H100 baseline).
title: [Bug][diffusion] JoyAI-Image-Edit fails at ImageEncodingStage: Qwen3-VL text encoder missing `mm_token_type_ids`
